estimates: The model covers three surviving exteriors and the ceremonial stair. Most of the former prison was demolished after 1980. The original demolished wings, prison walls, burial ground and interiors are outside the scope.
Heights, small facade divisions, facade material colors, mansard and warehouse roof framing and stair landings are estimated from written and geographic evidence.
The original terrain sets the approach and warehouse grade. Nearby river surface, railway, streets and private properties are supplied by the surrounding Earth context.

review.notes: Checked Qualla imagery first. The cleared story illustration depicts the unrelated Peace Arch. The archival 1877 construction photograph was not used because the native rights record does not establish its U.S. public-domain basis. Geometry follows written heritage and park records and native mapped outlines.
